injuries.detail: Murray-Boyles will not return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to an illness, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Barrett (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the Wizards, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Barnes (injury management) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Washington, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
Leonard (knee) has progressed in his strength and conditioning program but will miss at least one more week, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.
Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.
The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.
Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
